candidate.label: Intact mouse in a load-bearing pedal cradle
candidate.rationale: Preferred first investigation: retains original USB implementation and avoids all switch pinout assumptions. S1 describes buttons and USB use only for an exemplar. Mechanical fit and performance remain unmeasured.

spec.approach: An external hinged treadle presses exactly one existing button through a compliant adjustable pusher; original mouse remains intact.

decision_metrics.advance_if: Actual donor works, chosen action can bind, mechanical force/travel evidence supports safe load bypass.
decision_metrics.footprint: Larger; unknown until actual donor fit

spec.donor_identity: Unknown discarded wired USB mouse; B100 is exemplar only

evidence_packet.limitation: No specimen exists; original HTML hashes are locator provenance only; HS page-addressed document inspection rejected Markdown with 422 PDF signature requirement.

spec.evidence_status: Document-only design proposal; physical correctness remains unproven. No physical actions permitted in this trial.

host_behavior.mapping: Use native application mouse-button binding if available. A keyboard-only target requires device-specific host remapping, subject to later OS/application evidence.
host_behavior.single_action: One target application action on the chosen button down transition; suppress repeat while held; re-arm after release.
host_behavior.unwanted_inputs: Mount against translation; shield unused buttons and wheel; verify zero unwanted pointer/wheel/other button actions in target use.

mechanical_design.adjustment: Adjust mouse locating blocks, pusher position and stop only after actual envelope, button travel and allowable force are established. No dimensions are fabricated.
mechanical_design.load_path: Foot load goes through treadle, hinge and positive hard stop into a broad nonslip base; mouse shell/button is not the structural end stop.
mechanical_design.protection: Guard wheel and other buttons, retain cable strain relief, avoid pinch points; removal should restore ordinary mouse use.
mechanical_design.return: Independent treadle return bias must release the pusher; do not rely on the mouse switch to lift the pedal.

spec.system_boundary: Reuse original mouse USB cable/controller/firmware; no purchased development board and no firmware modification.
unknowns: Actual donor identity and functional state
Actual USB enumeration and button reports
Foot force, travel, return, slip resistance and useful service life
